title: structured-extraction case
description: One document (as text) and the fields that must be extracted from it.

input.description: the document text (OCR output, email body, PDF text); tokenise personal data first

tags.description: slices: format (clean, email, ocr), currency, language, document type

critical.description: e.g. high-value invoices and documents that must be rejected

review_status.description: draft cases (generated or harvested) are skipped until an expert marks them reviewed

split.description: representative (production-like) or stress (edge / adversarial); default from the stress tags

weight.description: production prevalence weight for representative cases (inverse inclusion probability from cases sample)

purpose.description: regression (default): gated, should keep passing; capability: a target not yet reached, reported but not gated

metadata.description: e.g. original file name or page count

fields.description: expected values, null where the document has none

injection_markers.description: security overlay: strings that appear only if a planted instruction was followed
